jobs.prompt: Add an already-delivered path to the ticket ledger (Ticket Manager v2 item 6). Today a ticket whose work was merged outside the ledger cannot become done: blocked to done is illegal and todo to done is refused, so requirements covered stays 0. Add `swarm tickets ID [ID...] --delivered PR[,PR] [--repo OWNER/NAME] --yes`: for every named ticket (status todo, ready, blocked or running; never cancelled or done) verify each PR is MERGED through an injectable dependency whose real default runs `gh pr view N --json state,mergeCommit,url` (tests inject a fake; no network in tests), then move the ticket to done with a ledger event kind delivered recording by owner, the PR numbers, the merge commit sha and the note; the ticket keeps the note delivered by PR #N (sha). Rules: a ticket with sensitive true is refused unless a passed security review is recorded for it (name the missing review, same message style as the existing --set done review gate; --yes never bypasses it); a PR that is not merged refuses with the PR number and state; --dry-run prints what would change; all-or-nothing per call; the ledger seal is recomputed like other ticket edits; done tickets release their files; requirement coverage and Build progress count delivered tickets as done. Implement in tools/tickets.mjs (transition helper) and the tickets command in tools/scope-commands.mjs (the flag parsing near the --set and --release handling around line 1723); do not edit tools/swarm.mjs. Tests in tests/tickets-delivered.test.mjs: merged PR marks done with the event, open PR refused, sensitive without review refused, cancelled and done refused, dry-run changes nothing, multiple tickets all-or-nothing, coverage counts it. ignoreTests reason: only tickets.mjs, scope-commands.mjs and the new test change.
